positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and developed UX for the Data Validation team, including data visualization charts, tables, and graphs to transform raw robotics data into final customer deliverables.
Delivered reusable custom components and backend endpoints using React and FastAPI, hosted on GCP, to support dynamic user interfaces.
Utilized BigQuery, GCP, and Airflow to build ETL data pipelines for robotics data management, editing, and validation.
Developed user-friendly workflows to enable seamless interaction with data pipelines.
Integrated 3D visualizations of robotics data using react-three and three.js to create asset visualizations to enhance users web experience.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · TypeScript · Python · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Integrated React JS into Django application, converted back end to Django REST, creating new front end application. 
Developed & maintained web application for data scientist.
Designed web UI/UX to optimize user experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Front-end focused web and mobile React development. 
Analyzed and determined the technical feasibility of UX designs.
Debugged and replicated production code issues.
Developed and executed end to end Mocha.JS test for enterprise workflow (Docker/Jenkins).
Developed Python scripts to resolve various production code issues.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Front end web development and database management for Patriot Missile Group and Software Engineering Department.
Performed production support such as trouble shooting and testing;   addressing defects through code enhancement as needed.
Fully managed maintenance and migration of Patriot and SED web apps (ten total) from legacy code to industry compliant standard.
Embedded at Integrated Defense Systems headquarters to conduct user research. Solicited customer feedback, specifications, and outputs for application enhancements. 
Identified business solutions in relation to current/future tech landscape. 
Wrote budget estimates and proposals: Decisions based on estimated business value from data driven research. 
Managed, tracked, and reported on development financials.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Researched and reported on new technology for Build and Deliver Technology group. 
Built email web API to send calendar notifications using ASP.Net 
Debugged standalone legacy .Net application using IntelliTrace.
Educated others on IntelliTrace software through published white paper

positions.title: Camp Counselor
positions.description:
Current Volunteer 
Supervised campers with cancer, heart disease, epilepsy, HIV, Sickle Cell,Spina Bifida, etc. at Overnight camp serves children with chronic or terminal illness.
Led 40 campers of various ages and abilities in sports and recreation type activities, as the Outdoor Fun Specialist.
